code: changes <- share_change(electricity_mix, from = 2005, to = 2025)  dplyr::filter(changes, country == "Australia", source == "coal") #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   country   source from_share to_share change change_per_year result             #>   <chr>     <fct>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>           <dbl> <chr>              #> 1 Australia coal         79.3     42.7  -36.6           -1.83 got 42.7% of its … # Coal's share of Australia's electricity fell by about 37 points  dplyr::filter(changes, country == "Indonesia", source == "coal") #> # A tibble: 1 × 7 #>   country   source from_share to_share change change_per_year result             #>   <chr>     <fct>       <dbl>    <dbl>  <dbl>           <dbl> <chr>              #> 1 Indonesia coal         39.0       NA     NA              NA has no coal data … # Indonesia's data end in 2024, so its change cannot be measured
